name: verdant-site
description: Verdant design system, demoed as a lightweight static site starter with defaults aligned to selected Web Sustainability Guidelines. Styled with PandaCSS.

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && panda cssgen -m --lightningcss -o dist/styles.css && node scripts/fingerprint.mjs && node scripts/stats.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.verify:ci: npm run build && npm run check:budgets && npm test
